facts.fact_text: On 10 May 2008 at 10 a.m., the applicant stood outside the Government building in Chișinău's main square.
On 10 May 2008 at 10 a.m., the applicant positioned a placard with the inscription "Hunger strike for rights" outside the Government building in Chișinău's main square.
On 10 May 2008 at 10 a.m., the applicant started a silent protest outside the Government building in Chișinău's main square.
Shortly after the applicant began his silent protest on 10 May 2008, police officers approached him.
Some of the police officers who approached the applicant asked him questions.
Some of the police officers who approached the applicant filmed him.
At approximately 10.45 a.m. on 10 May 2008, the applicant was approached by two persons wearing plain clothes.
In a video filmed by the applicant, one of the two plain-clothed persons can be seen ordering the applicant to stop filming.
The applicant refused the order to stop filming and stated that he is a journalist on hunger strike.
One of the two plain-clothed persons hit the applicant, apparently in the hand holding the camera.
One of the two plain-clothed persons threatened the applicant in rude terms with violence if he did not stop filming.
The applicant backed away while insisting that he had the right to film.
At the moment the applicant asked C.A. for identification documents, the applicant received another blow from C.A.
The second plain-clothed police officer appeared to forcefully put an end to the applicant's filming.
The second plain-clothed police officer seized the applicant by his clothes and hands.
Two uniformed police officers approached and apprehended the applicant.
The two uniformed police officers took the applicant to a police van without any resistance from the applicant.
The applicant arrived at the police station at approximately 11 a.m. on 10 May 2008.
The applicant's personal effects were taken away at the police station.
The applicant was questioned for approximately two hours at the police station.
According to the applicant, he insisted on being informed of the reasons for his arrest at the police station, but to no avail.
The applicant was detained for forty-eight hours in solitary confinement in a cell without windows.
According to Law No. 26 of 22 February 2008, in force at the time of the events, no authorisation is needed to hold a peaceful demonstration with fewer than fifty participants.

On 10 May 2008 at 10 a.m., the applicant started a silent protest outside the Government building in Chișinău's main square.
The second plain-clothed police officer retorted that by protesting the applicant was breaching the rights of other persons.
One of the two plain-clothed persons hit the applicant, apparently in the hand holding the camera.
At the moment the applicant asked C.A. for identification documents, the applicant received another blow from C.A.
The second plain-clothed police officer seized the applicant by his clothes and hands.
The two uniformed police officers took the applicant to a police van without any resistance from the applicant.
The applicant was detained for forty-eight hours in solitary confinement in a cell without windows.
The temperature in the applicant's cell was approximately fourteen degrees centigrade.
The applicant was wearing light clothes during his detention.
There was a concrete bed in the applicant's cell, covered with wooden boards but without any bedding.
There were no sanitary facilities in the applicant's cell.
The guards reacted to the applicant's request to be taken to a toilet only one or two hours later, when he screamed out loud in order to be heard by their superiors.
The applicant's request for a doctor during his detention was ignored.
Only the next morning after the applicant felt unwell was a doctor called.
